title: Context Length
description: Maximum prompt plus reply length in tokens. 0 takes the model's own length; a larger value is cut to what the model file allows. Applies from the next model load.

title: Speculative Decoding
description: Use the draft model built into the file to speed up generation, when the file has one. Applies from the next model load.

title: Timeout for LiteRT-LM
description: How long a LiteRT-LM model may take to load, in seconds: opening the file, creating the engine (compiling GPU shaders on the first run) and starting the host's server.
